core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Halimatun corresponds to the Arabic form حليمة (Arabic root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m); حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma)). Its core sense is patient, forbearing, gentle. Halimatun is a transliteration of Arabic حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma) with the case-ending (tanwīn) written out, as it appears in classical Arabic prose. The source gloss 'graceful, beautiful' is unsupported. The lexical sense of the underlying form is 'patient, forbearing'. Recorded at low confidence because the written-out case ending is a grammatical form rather than a distinct name.

persian.name: حلیمه
